verdict.rationale: The Working Copy manual has a passage on Git submodules ('allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate'), which suggests the app supports them. However, the evidence only defines what submodules are and does not describe how to clone, update or manage them in the app. Missing for 10: documented recursive clone of submodules, submodule update/sync operations, add/remove/manage workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
